need: Release the 10 finished Legendaries waiting for art
why: They are designed and tested; each needs only its art uploaded. They add two cards to every faction.

need: A 2-energy unit that wins early fights
why: Void is the weakest faction. Its 2-energy units are small (2/3, 2/5 and a plain 3/3), and Rift Stalker hurt the decks that ran it in both simulation runs.

need: Removal that fits the Grow theme
why: Nebula has only two removal spells, the fewest of any faction, so its units get outgrown by bigger enemies.
Comet has eight cards at 2 energy but only two at 3 and one at 5, so its decks run out of good plays mid-game.
Neither faction has a card at 6 energy, so decks jump from 5-cost cards straight to their 7-cost Legendary. (Void's Devour, waiting for art, fills Void's gap.)

need: Four to six cards any deck can use
why: Star Map is the only neutral main-deck card. Neutral cards give every deck more choices and add variety to packs.

need: A second way to pressure the enemy Commander
why: Lunar has a dozen healing cards but only Moontide Siren turns that healing into damage, so its games drag on.

need: Rework the cards that lose games
why: Perihelion Dash, Frostwake Tide, Deflect, Heat Wave and Bloom Surge hurt their decks in both simulation runs. Fixing them adds depth without adding cards.
